senses.gloss: c. (לפס, cmp. לפף) a tightly covered pot, stew-pot, v. אִלְפֵּס.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:17">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> top [read:] <he>כל׳ הזה וכיסויו</he>, v. <cite ref="A01942"><he>אִלְפֵּס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:4:3">Y. Shebi. VI, end, 37ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ אחד של ירק</he> a stew of vegetables.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:4">Peah VIII, 4</cite> <he>מלִפְסוֹ</he> out of his stew.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:2:3">Y. Ned. VI, beg. 39ᶜ</cite> <he>היורד לל׳</he> a dish prepared in the stew-pot; (Bab.
<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:11">ib. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>היורד לאילפס</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 3:2">Tosef. ib. III, 2</cite> <he>הנעשין באילפס</he>).
<cite ref="Chullin 84a:21">Ḥull. 84ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>יקח ללִפְסוֹ וכ׳</he> may buy for his stew a litra of &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לְפָסִים</he>, <he>לְפָסִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:13">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:13">XVII</cite>), 13; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:4:2">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="O01705"><he>סָתַם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:5">Eduy. II, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01603"><he>אִירוֹנִית</he></cite>; a. e.
